name: Enhance Prompt
description: Turn a rough idea into a clear, structured prompt for your coding agents with your own OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API key, then send it to an agent terminal. History, presets and optional auto-enhance.

commands.title: Enhance Prompt: Cycle auto-enhance mode (off / rules / AI)

statusBarItems.tooltip: Auto-enhance prompts Orca sends to agents. Click to cycle off / rules / AI.

settings.title: Provider
settings.description: OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Together, Ollama, LM Studio and any /chat/completions endpoint.

settings.title: API base URL
settings.description: Leave empty for the provider default (https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://api.anthropic.com). Examples: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1.

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Leave empty for the provider default (gpt-4.1-mini or claude-haiku-4-5).

settings.title: Custom instructions
settings.description: Extra rules for the rewriter, e.g. your stack, coding conventions, or 'always ask the agent to run tests'.

settings.title: Include workspace context
settings.description: Tell the rewriter the focused workspace name and branch.

settings.title: Include project instructions
settings.description: Read AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / README.md (first few KB) and the top-level file list of a local workspace, so the enhanced prompt fits the project.

settings.title: Terminal lines as context
settings.description: How many recent lines of the target agent terminal to give the rewriter (0 = none).

settings.title: How to send multi-line prompts
settings.description: Bracketed paste keeps line breaks in Claude Code, Codex and most agent CLIs. Single line joins lines with spaces.

settings.title: Press Enter after sending
settings.description: Off lets you review the prompt in the agent before submitting it.

settings.title: History size
settings.description: How many enhancements to keep (0 turns history off).

settings.title: Auto-enhance prompts Orca sends to agents
settings.description: Applies to launch, task and orchestration prompts (Orca never hooks prompts you type yourself). Rules appends the text below instantly. AI rewrites with the model but Orca waits at most 2 s, so use a fast model; on timeout the original prompt is sent.

settings.title: Auto-enhance: text to append
settings.default: Before you finish: keep changes minimal and focused, follow the existing code style, run the relevant tests or type checks, and summarize what you changed.

settings.title: Auto-enhance: minimum prompt length
settings.description: Skip prompts shorter than this many characters.
